components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sea Glass pill for the main action. Lifts 2px and brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 13px 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--acc, #227c9d); color: var(--onacc, #fef9ef); font-family: termina, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; border: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), filter 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.1); color: var(--onacc, #fef9ef); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--acc, #227c9d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Hairline pill for the secondary action. Stroke goes to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 13px 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #12414f); font-family: termina, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(18, 65, 79, 0.16)); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), border-color 0.3s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--ink, #12414f); color: var(--ink, #12414f); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #12414f); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Work-index filter. On-state is ink fill with paper type.
components.css: .ds-filter { padding: 9px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(18, 65, 79, 0.16)); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #12414f); font-size: 13px; font-family: termina, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-filter-n { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", monospace; font-size: 10px; color: var(--mute, #47606a); } .ds-filter:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #12414f); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #12414f); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-filter-on { border-color: var(--ink, #12414f); background: var(--ink, #12414f); color: var(--paper, #fef9ef); } .ds-filter-on .ds-filter-n { color: var(--paper, #fef9ef); }

components.name: Primary Nav

components.html: HomeWorkAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 11px; font-size: 13.5px; font-family: termina, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink, #12414f); opacity: 0.5; transition: opacity 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-on { opacity: 1; color: var(--ink, #12414f); } .ds-nav-rule { position: absolute; left: 11px; right: 11px; bottom: 7px; height: 2px; background: var(--acc, #227c9d); transform-origin: left; transform: scaleX(0); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-on .ds-nav-rule { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--acc, #227c9d); outline-offset: 3px; opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview:
A personal site set like a composed spread. Termina builds the architecture of the page; Roboto Serif does the reading; JetBrains Mono is the tools left on the desk — kickers, meta, labels, the blinking caret. It is paper, not a product UI. The implements annotate the work rather than chrome it.

Density is editorial. One very large display size, hairline rules, auto-fit grids, and cream laid ground with a print-pattern grain. Personality lives in the pairing and the texture. Actions are soft pills; surfaces are quiet 4px rectangles. Hover lifts a card a few pixels and turns its border to ink. Nothing casts a shadow.

Visual rejections already in the code: no drop shadows, no glass, no gradient heroes, no tech-startup chrome. Empty image frames stay dashed until a real asset exists. Dark theme inverts the stock (deep teal paper, cream ink) and brightens Sea Glass; the print grain multiplies into the night paper.
keyCharacteristics: Cream laid paper, Deep Teal Ink, Sea Glass actions, scarce Vermilion Spark
Three type voices only (Termina, Roboto Serif, JetBrains Mono)
Flat hairline surfaces; lift-on-hover is the only physical move
Print-pattern grain as paper, not decoration layered on top
Honest dashed slots where images are missing

rules.name: The Rare Vermilion Rule
rules.body: Vermilion stays scarce. Tiny marks are the default; occasional larger fills are allowed. Sea Glass remains the primary action fill.

rules.name: The Two-Stock Rule
rules.body: Light is teal ink on cream laid. Dark is cream ink on deep teal paper. Do not introduce a third ground (pure white, cool gray, or black).

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Termina for structure and display. Roboto Serif for reading and the italic accent. JetBrains Mono for tools. Do not add a fourth family.

rules.name: The Italic Accent Rule
rules.body: One italic Roboto Serif word may sit inside a Termina headline, in Sea Glass, at 1.18em, with the variable-font settle (wght 460 / GRAD 40 / wdth 122 → 400 / 0 / 100 over 4s). Use it as a stress, not a style for whole sentences.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Hairlines only. Hover may lift and darken the border to ink. Shadows are not a response to state.

rules.name: The Soft-Action Rule
rules.body: Pills for things you press. 4px for things you read. 3px for tiny chips. Do not invent a new radius.

dos: Do keep the three voices in their jobs: Termina structure, serif reading, mono tools.
Do set pages on Cream Laid with the print-pattern grain and the documented blend modes.
Do use Sea Glass for primary fills, links, and the italic accent.
Do leave empty frames dashed and labeled until a real asset exists.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion (animations collapse to 0.01ms) and keep the 44px nav/filter targets.
Do section with hairline line rules (and the 2px ink rule under the resume name only).
donts: Don't add drop shadows, glass, gradients, or a third paper color.
Don't introduce a fourth type family.
Don't make Vermilion the default primary-button fill; rarity is the point even when a larger mark is allowed.
Don't set paragraphs in Termina or headlines in mono.
Don't hide placeholder work or missing portraits behind invented images.
Don't treat the hover lift as permission to build an elevation scale.
